title: Replace the Substring for Balanced String
goal: Find the shortest substring whose replacement makes Q W E and R equally frequent.
strategy: Track counts outside a candidate replacement window. The window is sufficient once every outside count is at most one quarter of the total length; its replacement can supply all missing characters.

edgeCases: An already balanced string needs no replacement
